## Dead-end register

| Dead end | Severity | Status | Paths | Owner | Problem |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D-001 Request sent removes correction path | high | known_gap | N-014 | P-022 | After Mina sends a payment request, she can lose the ability to add a forgotten expense. |
| D-002 Premature close action | high | known_gap | N-005 | P-022 | Finish group can appear while Leo still owes money. |
| D-003 Partial payment treated as full payment | high | unreviewed_risk | N-010 | P-025 | A partial payment could clear the whole obligation. |
| D-004 Mismatched payment clears wrong share | critical | unreviewed_risk | N-011 | P-025 | Wrong payer, receiver, amount, currency, or reference could clear a share. |
| D-005 Guest can mutate organizer-owned state | critical | partly_mitigated_backend_unproven_ui | N-021 | P-025 | Backend settlement routes enforce active membership and payer/receiver checks, but guest-link UX proof is not mapped for low-risk payer-only recovery, return, and denial states. |
| D-006 Normal settlement state model cannot express delay, waiver, dispute, rejection, or expiry | critical | not_built | N-007, N-011, N-013, N-018, N-019, N-020 | P-025 | Normal settlement legs only support pending, paid, and confirmed, while the product map needs delayed, waived, disputed, rejected/not received, expired, duplicate, and wrong-payment paths. |
| D-007 Backend confirmation can auto-close before readable closeout review | critical | built_wrong_order | N-012, N-023, N-024 | P-004 | The backend marks the pot completed and writes chapter_closed when the final leg is confirmed, but the product journey expects Mina to review and close a readable record after all items resolve. |
| D-008 Close with note can hide unresolved money instead of requiring an explicit resolution type | high | built_ambiguous | N-018, N-019, N-023, N-024 | P-004 | CloseoutReview allows open paid/pending items to close with a freeform note, but it does not force the user to classify each item as delayed, waived, disputed, or unresolved. |
| D-009 Settle flow records payment intent/chapter proposal, not payer completion | high | built_ambiguous | N-005, N-008, N-009 | P-002 | SettleHome primary action says Mark paid or Mark received, but useSettlementActions proposes pending settlement legs. Payment completion still requires a separate ChapterPanel mark-paid action, creating two competing meanings for request, mark paid, and settlement. |
| D-010 Partial payment has no normal-pot representation | high | not_built | N-010 | P-025 | Settlement legs store one amount and only transition pending to paid to confirmed. There is no first-class partial amount, remaining balance, or partial confirmation state in normal pot settlement. |
| D-011 Add/remove member after request is not represented as a safe follow-up path | high | not_built_or_unproven | N-016, N-017, N-015 | P-022 | Members can be added/removed in the pot UI, but the map has no proven behavior for membership changes after requests or settlement legs exist. |
| D-012 Wrong payment is tested in capture/PAS lane, not normal settlement lane | high | lane_mismatch | N-011 | P-025 | Wrong-currency/missing-funds protection exists in capture/PAS tests, but the normal settlement backend accepts method/reference and has no typed wrong-amount, wrong-currency, duplicate, or expired payment state. |
